exposure: single balloon catheter (BC) for labor induction
cohort: The study included 321 term pregnancies with positive group B Streptococcus requiring induction of labor.
finding: When prophylactic antibiotics were administered, no significant differences were observed in maternal or neonatal adverse events between labor induction using a single balloon catheter and dinoprostone in term pregnant women with group B Streptococcus colonization.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in the mode of delivery between the balloon catheter and dinoprostone induction methods.
